scope: one offline Chromium practice, SwiftShader; no online clients

bounds.label: Vajra Gada · LMB. Sweep the mace in a short frontal arc. Step back, go behind him, or use cover.
Vajra Kavacha · Q. Shield yourself and allies in the marked forward fan for three seconds. Cover separates allies from the ward.
Maruti Udayana · E. Vault forward toward the marked endpoint. Solid obstacles shorten the route. The vault deals no damage.
Lanka Dahan · C. Fan embers behind you with your tail. Enemies in the marked sector take a burst, then damage while they stay in it.
Mountain Pulse · X. Mark a clear patch of ground and send the mountain's pulse. It harms enemies and restores allies at the landing. Leave the mark or use cover.
Vanara Sena · V. Call five fleeting guardian echoes to a clear area. Enemies inside take an initial hit and gradual damage; leave the marked area or use cover.
